hypothesis: Prefill tile/warp/stage sweep: wrap the prefill/non-split _attn_fwd launch (Sq > 16) in triton.autotune over (BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, num_warps, num_stages) candidates {64x64 w4 s2 (current), 64x64 w4 s1, 64x64 w8 s2, 64x32 w4 s3, 128x64 w8 s2, 128x64 w8 s1, 128x32 w8 s2, 64x128 w8 s1}, keyed on SEQ_Q, SEQ_KV, CAUSAL, HEAD_DIM. Decode/split path and small-Sq path unchanged.
rationale: Profile of HEAD on prefill_8192: 255 registers/thread (likely spilling: 64x128 fp32 acc + Q + S tile across only 128 threads), 57 KB smem -> 1 block/SM, theoretical occupancy 8.33% (4 warps per SM), SM throughput only 25.7%. Prefill rows are the weakest (~0.62-0.74x FA2). Configs with 8 warps halve per-thread state (no spills) or double warps per SM at BLOCK_M=128 (more MMA work per K/V tile, better latency hiding); stages=1 variants cut smem to allow 2 blocks/SM. Letting the autotuner pick per shape is a single parameter-family sweep.
expected_effect: Prefill rows improve substantially (target 1.3-1.6x over HEAD prefill times, toward ~0.9-1.0x FA2); decode rows unchanged. Geomean up from 0.79 to roughly 0.9-0.95.
